 * **Gemini 4 Carbon (`gemini-4-carbon`):** Built for tasks that push the limits of reasoning depth.
 Carbon spends more thinking tokens per turn to explore thoroughly and verify its work, which increases per-turn token use and latency compared to Argon.
 Use it for complex root-cause debugging, architectural design, dense multimodal synthesis, scientific proofs, and security auditing.
+
 * **Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`):** Our efficient Gemini 4 frontier reasoning model, ideal for most advanced software engineering and knowledge work tasks.
 It delivers Gemini 4 intelligence with faster responses and lower token spend per turn compared to Carbon on interactive coding, day-to-day feature work, and fast production loops.
 
-For more guidance on model selection, see [Latest Gemini models](/docs/latest-model#compare-models).
+* **Gemini 4 Hydrogen (`gemini-4-hydrogen`):** Fast and cost-efficient ($1.50 / $7.50 per 1M tokens, plus a Free tier) for everyday coding, interactive apps, multimodal documents, and parallel subagent execution.
 
+
+For side-by-side comparisons and multi-model orchestration examples, see [Choosing a model](/docs/choosing-a-model) and [Latest Gemini models](/docs/latest-model#compare-models).
+
